sentences.zh: 鄉人墻救，禽春，得贓千萬，其黨數十。

translations.literal: Villagers scaled walls to rescue; they caught Chun, got stolen goods worth tens of millions, their gang several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Villagers scaled walls to rescue. They caught Chun, got stolen goods worth tens of millions, their gang several tens.

sentences.zh: 小娥悉疏其人上之官，皆抵死，乃始自言狀。

translations.literal: Xiaoe fully listed the men and reported to the magistrate — all were punished to death; then she herself stated the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoe fully listed the men and reported to the magistrate — all were punished to death. Then she herself stated the facts.

sentences.zh: 刺史張錫嘉其烈，白觀察使，使不為請。

translations.literal: Prefect Zhang Xi praised her fierceness, reported to the investigating commissioner, who had her not request reward.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that prefect Zhang Xi praised her fierceness, reported to the investigating commissioner, who had her not request reward.

sentences.zh: 還豫章，人爭聘之，不許。

translations.literal: Returning to Yuzhang, people vied to betroth her; she would not consent.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to Yuzhang, people vied to betroth her. She would not consent.

sentences.zh: 祝髮事浮屠道，垢衣糲飯終身。

translations.literal: She tonsured and followed the Buddhist path, filthy clothes and coarse food for life.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that she tonsured and followed the Buddhist path, filthy clothes and coarse food for life.

sentences.zh: 楊含妻蕭，父歷，為撫州長史，以官卒，母亦亡。

translations.literal: Xiao, wife of Yang Han; father Li was prefect of Fuzhou, died in office; mother also died.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao, wife of Yang Han. Father Li was prefect of Fuzhou, died in office. Mother also died.

sentences.zh: 蕭年十六，與謂皆韶淑，毀貌，載二喪還鄉里，貧不能給舟庸，次宣州戰鳥山，舟子委柩去。

translations.literal: Xiao at sixteen, with Li both fair and gentle, marred her looks, loaded both coffins returning to village — poor, could not pay boat fees; stopped at Xuancheng Zhaniao mountain; the boatman abandoned the coffins and left.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao at sixteen, with Li both fair and gentle, marred her looks, loaded both coffins returning to village — poor, could not pay boat fees. Stopped at Xuancheng Zhaniao mountain. The boatman abandoned the coffins and left.

sentences.zh: 蕭結廬水濱，與婢穿壙納棺成墳，蒔松柏，朝夕臨，有馴鳥、縞兔、菌芝之祥。

translations.literal: Xiao built a hut riverside, with maid dug the grave and placed coffins, planted pine and cypress, morning and evening attended; tame birds, white rabbits, fungus omens appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao built a hut riverside, with maid dug the grave and placed coffins, planted pine and cypress, morning and evening attended. Tame birds, white rabbits, fungus omens appeared.

sentences.zh: 長老等為立舍，歲時進粟縑。

translations.literal: Elders built a lodge; each year they brought grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Elders built a lodge. Each year they brought grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 喪滿不釋蓑，人高其行。

translations.literal: When mourning ended she did not remove rush cloak; people exalted her conduct.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended she did not remove rush cloak. People exalted her conduct.

sentences.zh: 或請昏，女曰：「我弱不能北還，君誠為我致二柩葬故里，請事君子。」

translations.literal: Some asked marriage; the girl said: "I am weak and cannot return north; if you truly for me bring both coffins to bury in native village, I will serve you as wife."
translations.idiomatic: Some asked marriage. The girl said: "I am weak and cannot return north. If you truly for me bring both coffins to bury in native village, I will serve you as wife."

sentences.zh: 於是，含以高安尉罷歸，聘之，且請如素。

translations.literal: Then Han, dismissed as Gao'an district aide, returned and betrothed her, also asking as before.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Han, dismissed as Gao'an district aide, returned and betrothed her, also asking as before.

sentences.zh: 蕭以親未葬，許其載，辭其采。

translations.literal: Xiao, kin not yet buried, permitted him to carry them, declined his betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao, kin not yet buried, permitted him to carry them, refused his betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 已葬，乃釋服而歸楊云。

translations.literal: After burial she removed mourning and returned to the Yang clan.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that after burial she removed mourning and returned to the Yang clan.

sentences.zh: 韋雍妻蕭。

translations.literal: Xiao, wife of Wei Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao was wife to Wei Yong.

sentences.zh: 張弘靖鎮幽州也，表雍在幕府。

translations.literal: When Zhang Hongjing garrisoned Youzhou he memorialized Yong in the staff.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Hongjing garrisoned Youzhou he submitted a memorial Yong in the staff.

sentences.zh: 朱克融亂，雍被劫。

translations.literal: Zhu Kerong rebelled; Yong was seized.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Kerong rebelled. Yong was seized.

sentences.zh: 蕭聞難，與雍皆出，左右格之，不退。

translations.literal: Xiao heard calamity and with Yong both went out; attendants barred them — she did not retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao heard calamity and with Yong both went out. Attendants barred them — she did not retreat.

sentences.zh: 雍臨刃，蕭呼曰：「我茍生無益，願今日死君前。」

translations.literal: Yong faced the blade; Xiao cried: "If I lived without benefit, I wish today to die before you."
translations.idiomatic: Yong faced the blade. Xiao cried: "If I lived without benefit, I wish today to die before you."

sentences.zh: 刑者斷其臂，乃殺雍。

translations.literal: The executioner cut off her arm — then killed Yong.
translations.idiomatic: The executioner cut off her arm — then slew Yong.

sentences.zh: 蕭意象晏然，觀者哀嘆。

translations.literal: Xiao's spirit seemed tranquil; viewers sighed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao's spirit seemed tranquil. Viewers sighed.

sentences.zh: 是夕死。

translations.literal: That night she died.
translations.idiomatic: She died that same night.

sentences.zh: 大和中，楊志誠表其烈，詔贈蘭陵縣君。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong era Yang Zhicheng memorialized her fierceness; an edict posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Lanling county.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong era Yang Zhicheng submitted a memorial her fierceness; an edict posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Lanling county.

sentences.zh: 雍字和叔，擢進士第。

translations.literal: Yong, courtesy name Hezhu, passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yong, courtesy name Hezhu, passed the jinshi civil examination.

sentences.zh: 衡方厚妻程。

translations.literal: Cheng, wife of Heng Fanghou.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was wife to Heng Fanghou.

sentences.zh: 大和中，方厚為邕州錄事參軍。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong era Fanghou was merit recorder of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dazhong reign Fanghou served as merit recorder in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 招討使董昌齡治無狀，方厚數爭事，昌齡怒，將執付吏，辭以疾，不免，即以死告，臥棺中。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Dong Changling governed without propriety; Fanghou several times disputed affairs; Changling was angry, would seize and hand to clerks; he pleaded illness but could not escape — he then announced death and lay in the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Dong Changling governed without propriety. Fanghou several times disputed affairs. Changling was angry, would seize and hand to clerks. He pleaded illness but could not escape — he then announced death and lay in the coffin.

sentences.zh: 昌齡知之，使闔棺甚牢。

translations.literal: Changling knew it, had the coffin closed very tight.
translations.idiomatic: Changling saw through the ruse and had the coffin sealed very tight.

sentences.zh: 方厚閉久，以爪攫棺，爪盡乃絕。

translations.literal: Fanghou closed long, clawed the coffin — claws exhausted then he perished.
translations.idiomatic: Fanghou was shut in for a long while; he clawed at the coffin until his fingers gave out, and then he died.

sentences.zh: 程懼並死，不敢哭。

translations.literal: Cheng feared dying together, dared not weep.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng feared she would die with him and dared not weep aloud.

sentences.zh: 昌齡恬不疑，厚遣其喪。

translations.literal: Changling was calm without suspicion, thickly sent off the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that changling was calm without suspicion, thickly sent off the funeral.

sentences.zh: 程徒行至闕下，叩右銀臺門，自刵陳冤，下御史鞫治有實，昌齡乃得罪。

translations.literal: Cheng walked to the capital, knocked at the Right Silver Terrace Gate, mutilated herself stating the wrong; the censor investigated and found truth; Changling then was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng walked to the capital, knocked at the Right Silver Terrace Gate, mutilated herself stating the wrong. The censor investigated and found truth. Changling then was punished.

sentences.zh: 文宗詔封程武昌縣君，賜一子九品正官員。

translations.literal: Wenzong issued an edict enfeoff Cheng Lady of Wuchang county, granted one son ninth-rank regular official.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong issued an edict enfeoff Cheng Lady of Wuchang county, granted one son ninth-rank regular official.

sentences.zh: 鄭孝女，兗州瑕丘人。

translations.literal: The Filial Daughter Zheng, of Xiqiu in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng, the Filial Daughter, was from Xiqiu in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 父神佐，為官兵，戰死慶州。

translations.literal: Father Shenzuo was a soldier; died in battle at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Shenzuo was a soldier and fell in battle at Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時母已亡，又無兄弟，女時年二十四，即翦發毀服，身護喪還鄉里，與母合葬。

translations.literal: The mother was already dead; also no brothers; the girl then twenty-four cut hair and ruined dress, personally escorted the coffin returning to village, buried with mother together.
translations.idiomatic: The mother was already dead. Also no brothers. The girl then twenty-four cut hair and ruined dress, personally escorted the coffin returning to village, buried with mother together.

sentences.zh: 廬墓下，手樹松柏成林。

translations.literal: Below the tomb hut she planted pine and cypress into a grove.
translations.idiomatic: Below her mourning hut she planted pine and cypress until they formed a grove.

sentences.zh: 初，許適牙兵李玄慶，至是，謝不嫁。

translations.literal: At first she had promised to marry guard Li Xuanging — then she declined marriage.
translations.idiomatic: At first she had promised to marry guard Li Xuanging — then she refused marriage.

sentences.zh: 大中中，兗州節度使蕭俶狀於朝，有詔旌表其閭。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong era Yanzhou military commissioner Xiao Gu reported to court; an edict marked her lane.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong era Yanzhou military commissioner Xiao Gu reported to court. An edict marked her lane.

sentences.zh: 李廷節妻崔。

translations.literal: Cui, wife of Li Tingjie.
translations.idiomatic: Cui was wife to Li Tingjie.

sentences.zh: 乾符中，廷節為郟城尉。

translations.literal: In the Qianfu era Tingjie was district aide of Yancheng.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianfu reign Tingjie was district aide in Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 王仙芝攻汝州，廷節被執。

translations.literal: Wang Xianzhi attacked Ruzhou; Tingjie was seized.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianzhi attacked Ruzhou and seized Tingjie.

sentences.zh: 賊見崔妹美，將妻之，詬曰：「我，士人妻，死亡有命，柰何受賊汙？」

translations.literal: The bandits saw Cui's younger sister beautiful, would make her wife; she cursed: "I am a scholar's wife — life and death have fate; how could I suffer bandit shame?"
translations.idiomatic: The bandits saw Cui's younger sister beautiful, would make her wife. She cursed: "I am a scholar's wife — life and death have fate. How could I suffer bandit shame?"

sentences.zh: 賊怒，刳其心食之。

translations.literal: The bandits were angry, gouged out her heart and ate it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were angry, gouged out her heart and ate it.

sentences.zh: 殷保晦妻封，敖孫也，名絢，字景文。

translations.literal: Feng Xuan, wife of Yin Baohui, was Ao's granddaughter, named Xuan, courtesy name Jingwen.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Baohui's wife Feng Xuan Ao's granddaughter, named Xuan, courtesy name Jingwen.

sentences.zh: 能文章、草隸。

translations.literal: Able at essays, draft clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: She excelled at essays and could draft documents in clerical script.

sentences.zh: 保晦歷校書郎。

translations.literal: Baohui served as proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: Baohui held the post of proofreader.

sentences.zh: 黃巢入長安，共匿蘭陵里。

translations.literal: Huang Chao entered Chang'an; they hid together in Lanling lane.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao entered Chang'an, they hid together in Lanling Lane.

sentences.zh: 明日，保晦逃。

translations.literal: Next day Baohui fled.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Baohui fled.

sentences.zh: 賊悅封色，欲取之，固拒。

translations.literal: The bandits delighted in Xuan's looks, wished to take her; she firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were taken with Xuan's beauty and wished to take her; she steadfastly refused.

sentences.zh: 賊誘說萬詞，不答。

translations.literal: The bandits enticed with ten thousand words; she did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits tempted her with ten thousand words; she made no reply.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，勃然曰：「從則生，不然，正膏我劍！」

translations.literal: The bandits were angry, suddenly saying: "Submit and live — otherwise, my sword will anoint you!"
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were angry, suddenly saying: "Submit and live — otherwise, my sword will anoint you!"

sentences.zh: 封罵曰：「我，公卿子，守正而死，猶生也，終不辱逆賊手！」

translations.literal: Xuan cursed: "I am a minister's child — upright death is still life; I will never shame the rebel bandit's hand!"
translations.idiomatic: Xuan cursed: "I am a minister's child — upright death is still life. I will never shame the rebel bandit's hand!"

sentences.zh: 遂遇害。

translations.literal: She then met harm.
translations.idiomatic: She thereupon met harm.

sentences.zh: 保晦歸，左右曰：「夫人死矣！」

translations.literal: When Baohui returned, attendants said: "The lady is dead!"
translations.idiomatic: Once Baohui returned, attendants said: "The lady is dead!."

sentences.zh: 保晦號而絕。

translations.literal: Baohui wailed and expired.
translations.idiomatic: Baohui wailed and expired," she said.

sentences.zh: 竇烈婦者，河南人，朝邑令華某妻。

translations.literal: The Fierce Wife Dou, of Henan, wife of Magistrate Hua of Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Dou, the Fierce Wife, was from Henan, wife of Magistrate Hua of Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 初，同州軍亂，逐節度使李瑭走河中，令匿望仙里，不知所舍乃仇家也。

translations.literal: At first Tongzhou army rebelled, drove military commissioner Li Tang fleeing to Hezhong; the magistrate hid in Wangxian lane, not knowing the lodging was an enemy house.
translations.idiomatic: At first Tongzhou army rebelled, drove military commissioner Li Tang fleeing to Hezhong. The magistrate hid in Wangxian lane, not knowing the lodging was an enemy house.

sentences.zh: 夜半盜入，捽令首，欲殺之，竇泣蔽捍，苦持賊袂，至中刀不解，令得脫走不死，賊亦去。

translations.literal: At midnight robbers entered, seized the magistrate's head, wished to kill; Dou wept shielding, bitterly held the bandit's sleeve — cut to the middle of the blade without release; the magistrate escaped alive; the bandits also left.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight robbers entered, seized the magistrate's head, wished to kill. Dou wept shielding, bitterly held the bandit's sleeve — cut to the middle of the blade without release. The magistrate escaped alive. The bandits also left.

sentences.zh: 京兆聞之，歸酒帛醫藥，幾死而愈。

translations.literal: Jingzhao heard it, sent wine, silk, and medicine; nearly died then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao heard it, sent wine, silk, and medicine. Nearly died then recovered.

sentences.zh: 李拯妻盧者，美姿，能屬文。

translations.literal: Lu, wife of Li Zheng, beautiful bearing, able to compose literature.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that lu, wife of Li Zheng, beautiful bearing, able to compose literature.

sentences.zh: 拯字昌時，咸通末擢進士，遷累考功郎中。

translations.literal: Zheng, courtesy name Changshi, at the end of Xiantong passed jinshi, promoted to investigating director of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that zheng, courtesy name Changshi, at the end of Xiantong passed jinshi, promoted to investigating director of personnel.

sentences.zh: 黃巢亂，避地平陽，僖宗召為翰林學士。

translations.literal: When Huang Chao rebelled he avoided to Pingyang; Xizong summoned as Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao rebelled he avoided to Pingyang; Emperor Xizong summoned as Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 帝出寶雞，陷於嗣襄王煴。

translations.literal: The emperor went out to Baoji, fell to heir Prince of Xiang Wang Yun.
translations.idiomatic: So it was that the emperor went out to Baoji, fell to heir Prince of Xiang Wang Yun.

sentences.zh: 煴敗，拯死，盧伏屍哭。

translations.literal: When Yun was defeated Zheng died; Lu lay on the corpse weeping.
translations.idiomatic: When Yun was defeated Zheng died. Lu lay on the corpse weeping.

sentences.zh: 王行瑜兵逼之，不從，脅以刃，斷一臂死。

translations.literal: Wang Xingyu's troops pressed her; she would not submit; threatened with blade — one arm cut off and she died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xingyu's troops pressed her. She would not submit. Threatened with blade — one arm cut off and she died.

sentences.zh: 山陽女趙者，父盜鹽，當論死，女詣官訴曰：「迫饑而盜，救死爾，情有可原，能原之邪？

translations.literal: Zhao of Shanyang — her father stole salt, should be judged death; the girl went to the magistrate pleading: "Forced by hunger to steal, saving life only — feeling may be pardoned; can you pardon?
translations.idiomatic: Zhao of Shanyang — her father stole salt, should be judged death. The girl went to the magistrate pleading: "Forced by hunger to steal, saving life only — feeling may be pardoned. Can you pardon?

sentences.zh: 否則請俱死。」

translations.literal: If not, please die together."
translations.idiomatic: If you will not, then let us die together."

sentences.zh: 有司義之，許減父死。

translations.literal: The authorities deemed it righteous and permitted reducing father's death.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities deemed it righteous and permitted reducing father's death," she said.

sentences.zh: 女曰：「身今為官所賜，願毀服依浮屠法以報。」

translations.literal: The girl said: "My body is now what the office bestowed — I wish to ruin dress and follow Buddhist law to repay."
translations.idiomatic: The girl said: "My body is now what the office bestowed—I wish to ruin dress and follow Buddhist law to repay."

sentences.zh: 節截耳自信，侍父疾，卒不嫁。

translations.literal: She cut off an ear in oath, attended father's illness, to the end did not marry.
translations.idiomatic: She cut off an ear in oath, attended father's illness, to the end did not marry," she said.

sentences.zh: 周迪妻某氏。

translations.literal: A certain clan, wife of Zhou Di.
translations.idiomatic: A woman of a certain clan was wife to Zhou Di.

sentences.zh: 迪善賈，往來廣陵。

translations.literal: Di was skilled at trade, coming and going Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Di was skilled in trade and traveled back and forth to Guangling.

sentences.zh: 會畢師鐸亂，人相掠賣以食。

translations.literal: When Bi Shiduo rebelled people sold one another for food.
translations.idiomatic: When Bi Shiduo rebelled, people sold one another for food.

sentences.zh: 迪饑將絕，妻曰：「今欲歸，不兩全。

translations.literal: Di starving nearly dead, the wife said: "Now wishing to return — we cannot both survive.
translations.idiomatic: Di starving nearly dead, his wife said: "Now wishing to return — we cannot both survive.

sentences.zh: 君親在，不可並死，願見賣以濟君行。」

translations.literal: Your parents live — you cannot both die; I wish to be seen sold to aid your journey."
translations.idiomatic: Your parents live — you cannot both die. I wish to be seen sold to aid your journey."

sentences.zh: 迪不忍，妻固與詣肆，售得數千錢以奉。

translations.literal: Di could not bear it; the wife firmly went with him to the market, sold for several thousand cash to support him.
translations.idiomatic: Di could not bear it. The wife firmly went with him to the market, sold for several thousand cash to support him.

sentences.zh: 迪至城門，守者誰何，疑其紿，與迪至肆問狀，見妻首已在枅矣。

translations.literal: Di reached the gate; guards questioned who, suspected deception, went with Di to the market to ask — saw the wife's head already on the frame.
translations.idiomatic: Di reached the gate. Guards questioned who, suspected deception, went with Di to the market to ask — saw the wife's head already on the frame.

sentences.zh: 迪里餘體歸葬之。

translations.literal: Di wrapped the remains and returned to bury.
translations.idiomatic: Di wrapped what remained of her and returned home to bury her.

sentences.zh: 朱延壽妻王者，當楊行密時，延壽事行密為壽州刺史，惡行密不臣，與寧國節度使田頵謀絕之以歸唐。

translations.literal: Wang, wife of Zhu Yanhou — in Yang Xingmi's time Yanhou served Xingmi as Shouzhou prefect, hated Xingmi's disloyalty, with Ningguo military commissioner Tian Jun plotted to cut him off and return to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang, wife of Zhu Yanhou—in Yang Xingmi's time Yanhou served Xingmi as Shouzhou prefect, hated Xingmi's disloyalty, with Ningguo military commissioner Tian Jun plotted to cut him off and return to Tang.

sentences.zh: 事泄，行密以計召延壽，欲與揚州，延壽信之。

translations.literal: The affair leaked; Xingmi by stratagem summoned Yanhou, wishing to give him Yangzhou; Yanhou believed it.
translations.idiomatic: The affair leaked. Xingmi by stratagem summoned Yanhou, wishing to give him Yangzhou. Yanhou believed it.

sentences.zh: 將行，王曰：「今若得揚州，成宿志，具興衰在時，非系家也，然願日一介為驗。」

translations.literal: About to go, Wang said: "If now you get Yangzhou, your long wish is fulfilled; rise and fall lie in the times, not tied to family — yet I wish one messenger daily as proof."
translations.idiomatic: About to go, Wang said: "If now you get Yangzhou, your long wish is fulfilled. Rise and fall lie in the times, not tied to family — yet I wish one messenger daily as proof."

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: It was promised.
translations.idiomatic: [She said,]  It was promised.

sentences.zh: 及為行密所殺，介不至，王曰：「事敗矣。」

translations.literal: When killed by Xingmi the messenger did not arrive; Wang said: "The affair has failed."
translations.idiomatic: When killed by Xingmi the messenger did not arrive. Wang said: "The affair has failed."

sentences.zh: 即部家僕，授兵器。

translations.literal: She then arrayed household servants, handed out weapons.
translations.idiomatic: She thereupon arrayed household servants, handed out weapons.

sentences.zh: 方闔扉而捕騎至，遂出私帑施民，發百燎焚牙居，呼天曰：「我誓不為仇人辱！」

translations.literal: Just closing the door when arresting riders arrived, she then took private stores to give the people, lit a hundred torches and burned the yamen residence, cried to Heaven: "I swear not to suffer the enemy's shame!"
translations.idiomatic: Just closing the door when arresting riders arrived, she then took private stores to give the people, lit a hundred torches and burned the yamen residence, cried out to Heaven: "I swear not to suffer the enemy's shame!"

sentences.zh: 赴火死。

translations.literal: She rushed into fire and died.
translations.idiomatic: She rushed into fire and perished.
